definitions.full: H6825. Tsepho or Tsephi צְפִי צְפוֺ, proper name, masculine Σωφαρ : in Edom (? gaze, gazing ); — צְפוֺ Gen 36:11 , 15 + 36:43 (insert probably after עירם ; compare Lag Sept. Stud. ii.10.1. 178; 37, 1. 270 Nes Mar.12 ) = צְפִי 1Chr 1:36 .
